title: Denmark and Norway report new drone sightings over major military bases
summary: Unidentified drones spotted at the countries’ biggest military bases, Karup in Denmark and Orland in Norway Unidentified drones have been spotted over major military bases in Denmark and Norway, the latest in a series of sightings some officials have hinted might be linked to Russia. Drones were spotted on Friday night flying over Danish military sites including Karup, its largest base, while nearby Norway was also investigating “possible sightings of drones” early on Saturday near its biggest military base, Orland.
